title.narrative: Supporting adaptation capacity through increased insurance penetration in Africa (SACPIP-Africa)

description.narrative: The activities in this project aim at expanding parametric insurance coverage throughout the African continent by enhancing engagement with ARC member states and diversifying the ARC Ltd. risk pool. More specifically, this project will “increase the financial resilience of populations that are vulnerable to climate-related disasters by equipping states to forecast, assess and manage the impacts of natural disasters and ensuring that households receive timely support”. This project supports countries to adapt to climate change and address loss and damage. As per ARC's gender strategy, gender issues are taken into consideration throughout the systematic process of disaster risk mitigation and the ARC program life cycle. E.g. gender is built into the capacity building work and in the risk models and contingency planning processes. Gender-responsive actions are monitored and supported.
